title: Binance Referral Code Not Working? Here Is Why
desc: Why a Binance referral code fails to apply, the three real causes, how to confirm it linked, and how to fix it properly.
body:
A Binance referral code that refuses to apply is one of the most common support questions, and almost every case has the same cause: the account was created before the code was entered.

Binance links a referral permanently at registration. There is no settings page that adds one afterwards, and support will not attach a code to an account that already exists. That single rule explains the large majority of "code not working" reports.

## The three real causes

- **The account already existed.** Registering first and hunting for a code field afterwards is the most common mistake. The fix is a new account created through the referral link.
- **The code field was edited or cleared.** It auto-fills from the link but stays editable. If it was cleared, retyped with a typo, or replaced by a pasted code from somewhere else, the referral is lost at submission.
- **A regional or account-type restriction.** Some jurisdictions and account types cannot participate in referral programs. In that case the field is absent rather than broken.

## How to confirm it applied

After registering, open the referral or rewards section of the account. A correctly linked account shows the referrer and the associated fee discount. If that section is empty, the code did not attach.

The discount itself shows up on your fee rate rather than as a separate balance. Compare your taker and maker rates against Binance's published standard tier: a linked account pays roughly twenty percent less.

## Fixing it properly

1. Open the referral link and confirm the code field reads exactly RMCTNB5R before submitting.
2. Create the account from that link, not from a search result or a bookmarked homepage.
3. Complete verification, then check the rewards section to confirm the link is registered.

If the account is already established and the code never attached, the only reliable route is a new account. That is inconvenient, which is why applying the code at the start matters more than it seems.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can Binance support add a referral code to my account?

No. Referral attribution is set at registration and is not editable afterwards, including by support staff.

### Does the discount still apply if I registered without a code?

No. Without a linked referral the account pays the standard published fee rate.

### Is the 20% discount permanent?

Yes. A linked referral discount does not expire while the account remains active, which is why applying it correctly at signup is worth the extra minute.
